author: robertomarin
quote: The music. The story. The gameplay. It’s just incredible. The remake feels great. I don’t particularly love the hook shot spots, and minor details, but this doesn’t break the experience. I love the graphics so much, it’s simple and gorgeous. Amazing game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: robertomarin
quote:
Well, for about 450 BRL I was expecting way more. 

30 fps is terrible, why not just give a performance option? this is so silly nowadays to implement. Lazy, boring. 

About the game itself, I don’t care about doing the workout or painting the house. The problem is that every single dynamic is so casual. It’s interesting to see that “adults” will think this is for real gamers and other games for casual gamers, but the everyday here is very clunky and no challenging at all. 

Paint the house: move the stick 
Fix the stairs: R2 
Fiz the roof: R2 
Workout: L2 + R2 occasionally press X

Lazy lazy lazy gaming mechanics.

author: robertomarin
quote: I'm a huge Nintendo fan, so it hurts to say, but this is the best gaming experience I've had on my entire life, period. I've been playing games since 8 bit generation, and I can't describe how I felt when I did platinum this game. Amazing.

author: robertomarin
quote:
you start the game and you don't realize how close to one of the best gaming experiences you are.

the games looks ok at the beginning but it grows as you level up.

the levels are really challenging and the open world experience is well tuned.

not for gamers that are used to tutorials inside the game, think on super metroid with a very creative – not fool like other clones – environment and playability.

a must play for nintendo lovers.
